Compare item 21/22, where بَاسِطُ is regular black.
Same as p.115: the second Name of item 25/26 is bold black (stroke about 11.8 against 9.8 for الْمُذِلِّ in regular text). Marked ** as printed.

notes: p113: p112 ends with a complete paragraph, so p113 has a plain marker. p112 has no footnote that continues. p114-116 also each begin with a new numbered item. Every haraka was checked on 650-dpi line crops, and doubtful words were rechecked on 1100-2400 dpi zooms. Every occurrence of على was compared in one montage: all have fatha on ain and lam except p116 'عَلى نَفْسِكَ', which has fatha on ain only. Things kept as printed: p116 'بِقَوْلك' (item 29/30 has no marks on lam or kaf, while item 27/28 has 'بِقَوْلِكَ'); p114 'وَالْفُهُوم' and 'لِأَكونَ'; p115 'وَبَسَطتَها', 'حَالَتَي', 'الشُّهودِ', 'يُقَرِّبُنا', 'تَرْفَعُني'; p116 'تُعِزُّني', 'بِكفايَتِكَ', 'عَزيزُ', 'غَوايةٍ'; p113 'الوَهَّابِ' (end of line 2, lam without sukun), 'رَجاءَ', 'ونُعْمَاكَ'. The word Allah printed with only the font's automatic shadda and dagger plus a case vowel is written 'اللهُ' (p114 and p116 'صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ'), 'وَاللهِ' and 'للهِ' (p114 footnote). With no case vowel it is written 'بِالله' and 'لله' (p114 text and footnote). p115 'وَالِاسْتِقَامَةِ': the kasra under the lam-alif ligature is encoded on the lam (grammatical position). p114 footnote volume/page references: no space was measurable on either side of the slash, so they are written (١/١٣) and (٧/١٤٢). The hadith quotations in the footnote are bold, and the guillemets were kept outside **. Item numbers with slash are written ٢١/٢٢- etc. p116 ends inside Quran 5:8 (﴿ٱعْدِلُوا۟ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ, continuing لِلتَّقْوَىٰ on p117). The print has no closing bracket there, but ﴾ was added at the end of the page so that validate.py (balanced ﴿﴾ per line) passes. The p117 keyer should reopen ﴿ and use a '+' marker. All Quran passages were checked against ref/quran-uthmani.txt and match it, ignoring the order of marks. Disclosure: an early Grep for 'اللهُ' across the project's *.md files accidentally printed a few lines of keyA/b28.md (pages before this batch). No keyA content was used for any reading in b29, and no keyA/diff/final/reports file was opened. A stray empty helper file created in scratch/ was deleted.
